# Test fixture provenance & licenses

All fixtures in this directory are **original, handcrafted files created for this
project** and are released under the same license as the crate
(`MIT OR Apache-2.0`). No third-party sample files are bundled.

| Path | Description | Origin |
|------|-------------|--------|
| `csv/basic.csv` | Headers + quoted field containing a comma | handcrafted |
| `csv/bom_utf8.csv` | Leading UTF-8 BOM | handcrafted |
| `csv/semicolon.csv` | Semicolon-delimited (European locale) | handcrafted |
| `csv/tabs.tsv` | Tab-delimited | handcrafted |
| `csv/quoted_newlines.csv` | Quoted fields with embedded newlines and escaped `""` | handcrafted |
| `csv/crlf.csv` | CRLF line endings | handcrafted |
| `csv/cr_only.csv` | Bare-CR line endings, no trailing newline | handcrafted |
| `csv/empty_fields_no_trailing_nl.csv` | Empty fields, ragged rows, no trailing newline | handcrafted |
| `csv/edge_types.csv` | Type-inference edge cases (leading-zero text, currency) | handcrafted |
| `xlsx/sample.xlsx` | Known-value workbook (numbers/text/bool/error/formula/date/merge) | generated by `examples/gen_fixtures.rs` |
| `xls/sample.xls` | Same known-value workbook in BIFF8 | generated by `examples/gen_fixtures.rs` |

## Regenerating the binary fixtures

```sh
cargo run --example gen_fixtures
```

## On external test corpora

The research notes (RESEARCH.md) list permissively-licensed corpora from
calamine (MIT), readxl (MIT), and xlrd (BSD) that are useful for broader
conformance testing. They are intentionally **not vendored** here to keep the
repository self-contained and license-clean; to test against them, clone those
projects and point the readers at their sample files.
